groups.talkText: Do you have a big move coming up? Look no further than Martin Movers! We can pack up all your belongings and get them where they need to go in our spacious moving trucks. Customers rave about how fast, clean, and reliable our service is. We are proud of our ten years of experience serving the community. To celebrate our tenth anniversary, we're waiving the cost of supplies for the month of May. That's free boxes, tape, and foam wrap for your breakables! Schedule today to get this great deal!

groups.talkText: Thank you to the Clayton Museum for inviting me to give this presentation about my most recent publication. My book focuses on the history of the pottery makers who used to thrive here in Clayton. In 1850 only one pottery company made clay bowls and containers. By the next century, over 50 factories were making tableware, such as plates and teacups. Tea sets were very popular at that time. As you can see, there are several antique tea sets on the table here next to the podium. You are welcome to come and take a closer look after I'm finished speaking.

groups.talkText: Welcome to our twenty-fifth annual software development conference. We have an exciting agenda prepared for you, including three keynote speeches. Our first speaker, Rodrigo Flores, is the creator of the mobile phone application Pocket Me, which currently has over a million users. And it was launched six months ago! You can find where he'll be giving his speech in our online program. Remember that for the first time, this year the conference is paper-free — use any of the QR codes available to access the schedule.

groups.talkText: Good afternoon, everyone. As chief operating officer, one of my responsibilities is to look for ways to reduce costs. With this in mind, the executive leadership team and I have made the decision to consolidate our company from two locations to one — and one of our buildings will be sold. And since many of you have expressed interest in hybrid work schedules, employees will be able to work from home or in the office on different days of the week. Please think about a schedule that would best suit your work productivity. Be sure to discuss it with your manager by the end of this week.

choices.B: It will have its name changed.

groups.talkText: Would you like to go on a camping trip but don't have the right supplies? Grove Emporium is here to help. Right now during our year-end clearance event you can get incredible deals on new tents, sleeping bags, and other items. In addition, a portion of the proceeds will go towards repairing hiking trails at our local nature center. Our Greenville store location will not be participating in the sale this year because it's closed for renovations, so this sales event is taking place exclusively at our Town Square location. Take advantage of the great prices at Grove Emporium today.

groups.talkText: I'll be conducting a refresher training for all certified forklift operators in the warehouse next week, but I need to make you aware of a few things now. It's come to my attention that only the crew working the morning shift has been completing the forklift inspection checklist. However, the forklifts must be inspected at the beginning of every eight-hour shift. That's three times a day. Also, if you notice anything that isn't functioning properly, please don't forget to document it. We have a logbook on the wall over there for this purpose.

groups.talkText: Today I'll be presenting the work of Moritz Hoffman. Moritz spent the last two years designing and renovating the city hall building, saving a truly historic building — one of the oldest in Madison. A project of this scale requires a great deal of careful planning and attention to detail. And Moritz spent a great deal of time on preparation. The whole process was documented with photographs. Now, let's look at some slides of the city hall before and after renovations.

groups.talkText: Hi, everyone, and welcome to Baking Matters, the show where famous cooks share their delicious recipes with us. Before we get started with today's program, don't forget to sign up for our newsletter. You can sign up on our Web site, and it will be delivered right to your in-box. And now, for today's show, we have a cake-designing lesson led by expert baker Heather Silva. Heather has placed first in the Havenville Baking Competition three years in a row. And, just this month, she published her first book, titled Heather's Cake-Designing Tips. Look for it at your local bookstore. Now, grab your apron, and let's get baking!

groups.talkText: As you know, in March, our marketing agency won the industry award for "Most Innovative Television Commercial." After years of hard work, we're now an established name, and business is thriving. One of the individuals who has contributed significantly throughout our path to success is Scott Williams. So it's with some reluctance that I'm announcing that Scott has decided to embark on his retirement. It's certainly a loss for us, and we will miss his valuable insights. In light of this change, we'll need to modify a project team. Lauren is already successfully heading the marketing campaign for the Greyrock Financial account. So we're going to add her expertise to the Stelco Technologies account also.

groups.talkText: Welcome to Weston Sports Stadium! We are very pleased that you're joining us here for this special event. Tonight is the first time our hometown baseball team is playing in the regional championship! To celebrate, we'll be giving away prizes throughout the night. Our first prize goes to attendees who are in seats 23 through 30. They will each win a free ticket to a game next season! We'll announce more giveaways as tonight's game progresses. And don't forget to stay after the game. There will be a fireworks display.
